title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Native Engineering, Integrations
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

About Team
Flow by ServiceNow is a standalone conversational AI service desk, with its own product and its own codebase. Employees ask for help wherever they already work — Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or the browser. Flow answers from connected knowledge, handles the request, and runs automations the team publishes. AI is how the product works, and a person stays in control when the action is sensitive. 
Flow is a new company inside ServiceNow, reimagining every function from first principles. We hire builders with agency and curiosity who use AI as the default way to design, review, and operate. They challenge inherited ways of working and treat their work as craft. 
Flow is only as good as the systems it can read and the actions it can take. On Integrations, you’ll turn identity, devices, ticketing, documents, and chat into assets Flow can inventory, knowledge it can cite, and actions it can run — with each source’s permissions intact. 
In your first 12 months, you’ll make sure priority systems support assets, automations, and knowledge that Flow can actually use. Connection health and failed actions will be operable without a specialist in the room, and every new system will follow one contract for permissions, audit, and proof. 
Types of problems you’ll get to work on 
Integrations that power automations: Connect multiple systems (identity, devices, ticketing, documents, chat) and compose them into automations that run end to end. Own sync correctness, versioned behavior, and a repeatable contract for every provider as the catalog grows. 
Tool surfaces an AI can actually call: An action’s name, description, schema, and examples are the product surface a model sees. Design them so the assistant picks the right action first try, scope them so they are safe for an AI to call, and measure whether it does. 
Permissions and credentials you can prove: If a file is private to HR, a marketer must not see its title, its URL, or that it exists. Own access-model mirroring and delete detection, and pick the smallest credential policy each provider needs across validation, reconnect, revocation, and tenant isolation. 
AI-native development itself: Agentic coding is how this team ships, not a productivity add-on. Author the skills and guardrails that let agents do integration work correctly, keep the deterministic provider-fake harness that makes fast iteration possible, and review generated code critically before anything ships. 
Our stack 
TypeScript on Bun, PostgreSQL, Temporal for durable execution, Nango as the OAuth broker. We expect you to be excellent in a comparable stack and fluent in ours within weeks. We are not screening for this list.

To be successful in this role you have: 
- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. 

- Hands-on depth building and operating third-party integrations that real tenants depended on — webhooks, rate limits, pagination, incremental sync, delete detection. 

- 8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in system design, API design, relational data modeling, and testing. 

- Experience designing API or SDK surfaces that another system consumes correctly without a human reading the documentation — and interest in doing that for a model. 

- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. 

- Ownership of a versioned contract where a rename breaks a customer: stable identifiers, deprecation, and migration. 

- Sound judgment about least-privilege access — scope minimization per action, admin consent, secrets handling, tenant isolation — and about which actions an AI may take on its own. 

- Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build from 0–1 without a playbook. 

- A record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code-quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers. 

Nice to have 
- Experience evaluating tool or function selection — measuring whether a model picks the right action. 

- Experience with RAG or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 

- Familiarity with SCIM or directory sync. 

- Background in IT service management or employee support products. 

Why join us 
Intelligence is commoditizing. Connection and execution are not. A model that reasons brilliantly and cannot act on the systems a company actually runs is a demo. 
Flow already reaches a broad and growing share of the systems enterprises run day to day, and this team decides how fast that surface grows and how far each connection can be trusted. We aren’t writing connectors one at a time. We’re building the generator, the contract every provider follows, and the proof that what Flow says it did, it actually did. Real problems: a vendor specification that lies, an access model that must be mirrored exactly or not at all, a sync that resumes cleanly a million items later, and a tool surface a model has to get right without reading the documentation.

ABOUT IBN BATUTTAH
Ibn Batuttah (ibnbatuttah.com) is a travel platform in its pre-launch stage. Travellers build their own holiday day by day (flights, hotels, sightseeing, meals, transport), see the full cost, and compare it with travel agent packages. Travel agents get a portal to list live packages and serve their own customers. Admin manages bookings, payments and disputes.

The platform is built and currently in testing. A few features are still being completed, and we are fixing issues found in testing before launch. We need a developer who will take ownership, finish what's left and get it launch-ready.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN
• Complete the remaining features and fix issues found in testing
• Build and maintain features across React + Vite + Redux Toolkit and Node.js + Express + Sequelize (MySQL)
• Keep live flight and hotel supplier connections reliable: search, prebook, booking status, cancellations, sync jobs (node-cron + Redis)
• Look after Razorpay payments, markup and GST, vendor wallets and security deposits, and PDF vouchers/e-tickets (Puppeteer)
• Keep real-time chat and dispute flows (Socket.IO) working without lost messages
• Cut third-party API usage and cost, especially Google Maps/Places
• Speed up slow queries, APIs and pages
• Set up error monitoring, basic tests, database backups and safe releases
• Write clear documentation and guide junior developers

MUST-HAVE
• 3–5 years building and running live products with Node.js, Express and React
• Good MySQL and Sequelize: indexes, joins, migrations, transactions
• Redux Toolkit or React Query, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs
• At least one payment gateway integration (Razorpay or similar), including webhooks and failed payments
• Hands-on with Redis, cron jobs and basic Socket.IO
• Strong debugging of live production issues
• Comfortable deploying on Linux (Nginx, PM2)

GOOD TO HAVE

• Google Maps/Places, Mapbox or HERE APIs
• Puppeteer, Firebase, OpenAI API

• Sentry or similar monitoring, automated testing

AN HONEST NOTE FROM THE FOUNDER
I want you to know exactly what you are joining.

The risks:
• We have not launched yet. The platform is in testing, with a few features still being finished. No customers, no revenue, no guarantee of success.
• We are self-funded so far and raising investment. Nothing is certain.
• No perks at the start: no bonuses, no fancy office. A fair monthly salary, paid on time.
• Small team, and plans change fast.

Why join anyway:
• Real ownership of the whole platform, not one small part
• Learning you won't get elsewhere: live flights and hotels, payments, a marketplace, real-time chat and maps in one product
• You grow as the company grows: your salary, title and responsibility rise with it
• Direct access to the founder, with no layers
• A new idea the big travel sites don't offer

If you want a safe job with perks from day one, this isn't for you, and that's fine. If you want to build something from the ground up and grow with it, I'd like to talk to you.

— Aman Choudhary, Founder, Ibn Batuttah

DETAILS
• Salary: up to ₹55,000/month based on experience and test results, with a review after 6 months linked to launch and performance
• Location: Sector 63, Noida ([Office / Hybrid])
• Working days: [Monday–Saturday, 10 am – 7 pm]
• Joining: immediate or within a week

HOW TO APPLY
Apply here on LinkedIn or email [email address] with:
1. Resume and GitHub/portfolio link
2. Current salary, expected salary and notice period
3. Two live projects you built or scaled, and your exact role
4. A few lines on the hardest production bug you fixed

The Defect Prevention space is complex, highly scaled, and ripe for use of new technologies. We can use Gen AI to analyze patterns, assess root causes, evaluate image data, and ultimately craft the right message to communicate with sellers on what has gone wrong.

### **Role Overview**

We are looking for a **Software Engineer – Back-End Development (Java)** to join our Technology team. The ideal candidate will have strong backend development skills with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, and cloud-native technologies.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Backend Development:**
    
  Design, develop, and maintain backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate.
* **API Development:**
    
  Build and maintain RESTful APIs with proper documentation and versioning.
* **Database Management:**
    
  Design scalable data models and optimize queries across MySQL, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
    
  Deploy and manage applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes.
* **Microservices Architecture:**
    
  Develop services aligned with microservices principles and ensure seamless integration.
* **Testing & Debugging:**
    
  Write JUnit test cases and debug backend systems for performance and reliability.
* Participate in technical discussions and contribute to solution design and implementation decisions.

  Review and validate technical deliverables to ensure compliance with quality and security standards.

  Share technical knowledge, provide peer support, and contribute to team learning initiatives.

  Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to continuous enhancement of engineering practices.

### **Experience & Skills Required**

* **Work Experience:**
    
  3 to 5 years in backend development, preferably in enterprise-grade systems.
* **Technology Known:**

  + Java 8+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, JPA
  + MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL
  + Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka
  + CI/CD tools and Git
  + Object-oriented programming and design patterns
  + JUnit testing

### **Qualifications**

Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
  
No mandatory certifications required.

### **What You Bring to Digit**

You bring solid backend development experience, a strong foundation in Java technologies, and a problem-solving mindset—helping Digit build scalable and reliable systems that power our digital insurance platform.
